Dear Solanteq Team,

I am writing to apply for the Google Ads Specialist position. With hands-on experience in digital marketing, SEO, and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to help improve your paid search performance and generate relevant B2B leads.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content strategy for client websites. I regularly use Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and guide decisions. My technical background includes building and optimizing WordPress sites, implementing structured data, and conducting technical audits—skills that help me quickly understand new products and industries.

I am particularly drawn to Solanteq's focus on fintech and payment technology. My ability to grasp complex topics and translate them into effective campaigns, combined with my analytical mindset, makes me confident I can identify optimization opportunities and develop successful Google Ads campaigns.

I am eager to bring my skills in keyword research, campaign structure, and conversion tracking to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Solanteq's growth.

Best regards,
